title: Malaysian-Style Fried Noodles
description: A fusion of Chinese and Malaysian flavors, this fried noodle dish is quick and satisfying to make. It's a great option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the soy sauce, biryani masala, and almonds, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the scallions and stir-fry for another minute, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Season with salt to taste, and serve hot.
